claims.statement: Directory role sync completed successfully at 02:10 and updated 214 role assignments without errors
claims.corroboration: Verified status from IT Identity authority
claims.limitation: Confirms sync success; does not confirm application received or cached the updates

claims.statement: Authorization failures on customer-records app reached 31% of record-open requests starting at 08:30, affecting all 214 users with overnight role changes
claims.corroboration: Alert data (verified) plus all support reporters are within the 214-user cohort
claims.limitation: Failure counts; does not indicate cause

claims.statement: Six-hour gap exists between directory sync completion (02:10) and authorization failures (08:30)
claims.limitation: Timing alone does not establish cause; rules out immediate sync failure

claims.statement: Customer-records app is caching entitlements locally rather than querying directory in real time
claims.corroboration: Contractor log references 'served from local store'
claims.limitation: Contractor evidence is tier-4 (untrusted) and unverified; requires independent confirmation

claims.statement: Entitlement cache version mismatch: app using version 41 while directory holds newer entitlements for the 214 users
claims.corroboration: Contractor log notes 'version 41' for denied users
claims.limitation: Tier-4 untrusted source; no directory-side version data; no app-side version confirmation

claims.statement: Release r7's dependency updates may have altered entitlement cache behavior, causing it to retain stale data
claims.corroboration: Release shipped 'last week', 'dependency updates' included; timing plausible but not direct
claims.limitation: No functional changes listed; speculative connection to authorization logic

capability_gaps.reason: Cannot directly inspect app's cached version without service diagnostics; contractor log is untrusted

capability_gaps.capability: Directory version state at 02:10 and current
capability_gaps.reason: Observability gap: directory team cannot see what app has stored; no version tracking visible

next_action.rationale: Sampled traces from record-open requests during the 08:30 window will show which entitlement version the app is checking against. This will discriminate between: (a) app is using stale cache version 41, (b) app never received the directory update, (c) something else entirely. Traces are read-only and authorized.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Confirm whether app-side cache version matches directory state; if mismatch confirmed, establishes version-mismatch as root cause and justifies a reversible mitigation (evict_entitlement_entries or rerun_role_sync)
